parts.name: PopoverRoot
parts.description: Holds the popover's open state and shares it with the parts inside it.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popover is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the popover.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popover is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state after the browser or a part opened or closed the popover. A press outside and Escape can't be refused: a controlled popover that keeps `open` true is shown again. It is called in a change of its own, after the popover's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the popover or hide it again after the browser showed it.

parts.name: PopoverTrigger
parts.description: The button that opens and closes the popover. The browser's `popovertarget` does both on a press.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Whether resting the pointer on the trigger also opens the popover. A press still toggles it.

props.name: delay
props.description: With `openOnHover`: how long the pointer rests on the trigger before it opens, in ms.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: With `openOnHover`: how long after the pointer leaves trigger and popup before it closes, in ms.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present on the trigger while its popup is open.

parts.name: PopoverPopup
parts.description: The popup: an element with `popover="auto"`, placed against the trigger with CSS anchor positioning. Style it with `:popover-open`, `::backdrop` and `@starting-style`.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger it lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between trigger and popup, in pixels.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: How far the popup is moved along the trigger's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of its anchor the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.

parts.name: PopoverTitle
parts.description: A heading that names the popup. The popup's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

parts.name: PopoverDescription
parts.description: A paragraph that describes the popup. The popup's `aria-describedby` points at it.

parts.name: PopoverClose
parts.description: A button that closes the popover.

parts.name: PopoverArrow
parts.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the trigger the popup is on. Absent until the popup first opens; a close keeps the last side.
